releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.12 contains service 0.2.5.10 and tray 1.0.0.8. Tray startup no longer forces the full WinForms MainForm native handle to be created while hidden. The first visible Show now performs normal native handle creation after the taskbar state is final, targeting the remaining USER32 stack overflow 0xc00000fd seen on 1.0.0.7. Extra first-show diagnostics are included. Existing update verification, rollback, terminal and Mesh recovery behaviour remain unchanged.
